name: Wealth or spending inconsistent with known means
description: Assets, lifestyle spending or purchases clearly exceed the customer's known legitimate income or declared wealth, with no verifiable source.
fp: Legitimate inheritance, windfalls or undeclared but lawful income may explain the gap; verify before escalating.

links.name: Wealth disproportionate to official income
links.ctx: A PEP or close associate holds assets, accounts or lifestyle spending far exceeding legitimate known earnings.
links.fp: Wealth can come from inheritance, prior private career or family business.

links.name: Wealth or spending inconsistent with known means
links.ctx: Large lump-sum contributions that exceed what the member's declared income and savings could fund.

links.name: Wealth inconsistent with official income
links.ctx: Assets and flows clearly exceed the legitimate income expected for the individual's official position.
links.fp: Family wealth and prior career can explain.

links.name: Purchase price inconsistent with buyer's known means
links.ctx: Property acquired is far beyond the buyer's declared income or wealth, with no verifiable source.
links.fp: Inheritance, business sale or gifts may explain.

links.name: Owner lifestyle inconsistent with declared profits
links.ctx: Spending, assets and property purchases exceed what reported profits could support.
links.fp: Family wealth or gifts could explain this.
